Cipher Capital Lp decreased its stake in Colfax Corp (CFX) by 77.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 25,472 shares of the fluid controls company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.01M, down from 115,505 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cipher Capital Lp who had been investing in Colfax Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.92 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.12% or $0.66 during the last trading session, reaching $31.77. About 336,116 shares traded. Colfax Corporation (NYSE:CFX) has declined 17.80% since May 7, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.35% the S&P500.
